title: Basel 2.5 IMA market risk capital with 60-day averages
deliverables: summary json: var_last, var_avg60, svar_last, svar_avg60, m_c, m_s, var_component, svar_component, capital
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily 10-day 99% VaR series [T] and sVaR series [T] (or returns to build them); m_c, m_s (3 + plus). DITANYAKAN: two components and capital (currency). RUMUS: card Core 1 capital = max(VaR_{t-1}, m_c avg60(VaR)) + max(sVaR_{t-1}, m_s avg60(sVaR)); avg over last 60 business days ending t-1. JAWAB: 1) VaR/sVaR series (positive losses). 2) last value and 60-day mean. 3) each max. 4) sum. 5) check capital = sum of components, each >= m x average when the multiplier binds.
formulas: capital = max(VaR_{t-1}, m_c VaR_avg60) + max(sVaR_{t-1}, m_s sVaR_avg60)
pitfalls: averaging over 60 calendar days or including day t

title: IMA capital from current VaR and sVaR only
deliverables: summary json: var, svar, m, var_component, svar_component, capital
frame: DIKETAHUI: one-day (or 10-day) VaR and sVaR at 99%; multiplier m (default 3); horizon. DITANYAKAN: capital and components. RUMUS: card Core 1 shortcut: capital = m VaR_10 + m sVaR_10; Core 2 VaR_10 = sqrt(10) VaR_1 if one-day given (toolkit scale_horizon). JAWAB: 1) scale to 10 days. 2) components m x VaR, m x sVaR. 3) sum. 4) report both components.

title: Basel traffic light zone and plus factor
deliverables: summary json: exceptions, zone, plus_factor, multiplier
frame: DIKETAHUI: exception count over 250 days (or hits [250]); base multiplier. DITANYAKAN: zone, plus factor, multiplier. RUMUS: card Core 4 green 0-4 plus 0; yellow 5:0.40, 6:0.50, 7:0.65, 8:0.75, 9:0.85; red >= 10: 1.00; m = 3 + plus; toolkit basel_traffic_light(exceptions, n=250, level=0.99). JAWAB: 1) count. 2) lookup. 3) m. 4) check plus non-decreasing in exceptions.
pitfalls: using a window other than the last 250 days

title: Counting backtesting exceptions from P&L and VaR
deliverables: per-date table: date, pnl, var, exception
summary json: n_exceptions, rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily P&L or returns [T]; VaR forecasts [T] (positive loss, made at t-1). DITANYAKAN: exception indicators and count. RUMUS: exception_t = 1{-PnL_t > VaR_t} (strict; card toolkit exceedances(returns, var_series, strict=True)); align VaR made at close t-1 with P&L of t. JAWAB: 1) align dates (shift VaR if stored on forecast date). 2) sign convention (VaR positive). 3) indicators. 4) count over last 250. 5) rate vs 1 - q.
pitfalls: comparing P&L to VaR with the same sign (never fires)

title: Stressed VaR by searching for the worst 250-day window
deliverables: per-window table: start, end, var
summary json: stress_start, stress_end, svar
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T] (long history); VaR model (HS or parametric) and level 99%; window 250. DITANYAKAN: stress window and sVaR. RUMUS: card Conventions: sVaR window = 250-day window maximising the SAME VaR model; VaR_w per window; sVaR = max_w VaR_w; scale to 10 days if required. JAWAB: 1) rolling windows. 2) VaR per window (same quantile rule). 3) argmax. 4) sVaR and dates. 5) check sVaR >= current VaR if current window searched.
pitfalls: choosing by max vol when the task says max VaR (or vice versa)

title: Stressed VaR on a given crisis period
deliverables: summary json: period, n_obs, svar_1d, svar_10d
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns with dates; stress period [start, end]; current positions/weights; level. DITANYAKAN: sVaR (1- and 10-day). RUMUS: apply the same VaR model as current VaR to returns inside the stated window (inclusive bounds), current weights; VaR_10 = sqrt(10) VaR_1. JAWAB: 1) filter dates inclusive. 2) portfolio returns with current weights. 3) VaR. 4) scale. 5) report.
pitfalls: using different confidence or model than current VaR

title: 10-day VaR: square-root-of-time vs overlapping 10-day returns
deliverables: summary json: var_1d, var_10d_sqrt, var_10d_overlap
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily returns [T]; level; method. DITANYAKAN: 10-day VaR by sqrt-of-time and/or overlapping 10-day returns. RUMUS: card Core 2 / V1 a: VaR_10 = sqrt(10) VaR_1 (toolkit scale_horizon(var_1d, 10)); V1 b: R10_t = sum_{k=0..9} r_{t-k} (log) or prod(1+r)-1 (simple), overlapping, VaR on R10. JAWAB: 1) 1-day VaR. 2) scaled. 3) overlapping series [T-9]. 4) VaR. 5) compare.

title: GARCH term-structure h-day VaR
deliverables: per-horizon table: h, var_h, sigma_h, var
frame: DIKETAHUI: GARCH(1,1) omega, a, b and sigma^2_{T+1} (or returns to fit); horizons [H]; level. DITANYAKAN: h-day variance and VaR. RUMUS: card Core 2 alt: VL = omega/(1-a-b); var_h = sum_{k=1..h} [VL + (a+b)^(k-1)(sigma^2_{T+1} - VL)]; VaR_h = z_q sqrt(var_h); toolkit fit_garch11. JAWAB: 1) fit (decimal units). 2) one-step forecast. 3) sum. 4) VaR. 5) compare to sqrt(h) sigma_{T+1}.

title: Parametric normal VaR and ES for capital
deliverables: summary json: mu, sigma, var, es, var_ccy, es_ccy
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T] or (mu, sigma); level q; horizon h; position value V. DITANYAKAN: VaR, ES (fraction and currency). RUMUS: card Core 3 VaR = z_q sigma sqrt(h) (zero mean) or z_q sigma - mu; ES = sigma phi(z_q)/(1-q); toolkit parametric_var_es(returns, level, dist='normal'), var_es_normal. JAWAB: 1) sigma (ddof stated). 2) z. 3) VaR, ES. 4) horizon. 5) x V.
formulas: VaR = z_q sigma sqrt(h) - mu h

title: Historical simulation VaR over a one-year window
deliverables: summary json: window, var_1d, var_10d, es
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns or P&L vectors [T]; window 250; level; quantile rule. DITANYAKAN: 1-day and 10-day VaR. RUMUS: VaR = -quantile(r_last250, 1-q) with pinned method (toolkit historical_var_es(returns, level, method)); ES = mean of losses beyond VaR; scale sqrt(10). JAWAB: 1) last 250 obs. 2) losses. 3) VaR, ES. 4) scale. 5) report quantile method.
pitfalls: pinned quantile method not applied in every call

title: FRTB expected shortfall at 97.5% with 10-day base horizon
deliverables: summary json: es_1d, es_10d
frame: DIKETAHUI: P&L or returns [T]; level 0.975. DITANYAKAN: ES_T (T = 10 days). RUMUS: card Core 5 ES = mean of losses beyond the 97.5% quantile (or normal sigma phi(z)/(1-q)); 10-day by sqrt(10) scaling of 1-day ES or overlapping 10-day P&L. JAWAB: 1) losses. 2) ES at 97.5%. 3) 10-day. 4) check ES_97.5 ~ VaR_99 for normal.

title: FRTB liquidity-horizon adjusted ES cascade
deliverables: per-bucket table: j, lh_j, es_j, scaled term
summary json: es_liquidity_adjusted
frame: DIKETAHUI: ES_T(P,j) for j = 1..5 (ES with only factors of LH >= LH_j shocked), T = 10. DITANYAKAN: liquidity-adjusted ES. RUMUS: card Core 5 ES = sqrt(ES_T(P)^2 + sum_{j>=2} [ES_T(P,j) sqrt((LH_j - LH_{j-1})/T)]^2), LH = {10,20,40,60,120}, ES_T(P) = ES_T(P,1). JAWAB: 1) order buckets. 2) scale factors sqrt((LH_j - LH_{j-1})/10). 3) squares. 4) sqrt of sum. 5) check result >= ES_T(P).

title: FRTB stress calibration of ES on a reduced factor set
deliverables: summary json: es_rs, es_fc, es_rc, ratio, es
frame: DIKETAHUI: ES on reduced factors in stress period ES_R,S; full factors current ES_F,C; reduced current ES_R,C. DITANYAKAN: calibrated ES. RUMUS: card Core 5 ES = ES_R,S x max(ES_F,C/ES_R,C, 1). JAWAB: 1) ratio. 2) floor at 1. 3) multiply. 4) report ratio and ES.

title: FRTB IMCC: half diversified, half by risk class
deliverables: per-class table: class, es
summary json: es_all, sum_class, imcc
frame: DIKETAHUI: ES for all factors and ES per risk class (IR, equity, FX, commodity, credit spread). DITANYAKAN: IMCC. RUMUS: card Core 5 IMCC = 0.5 IMCC(all) + 0.5 sum_classes IMCC(class) (each liquidity adjusted). JAWAB: 1) liquidity-adjust each. 2) sum classes. 3) weighted average. 4) check IMCC between all and sum.

title: FRTB IMA capital with 60-day averages and DRC
deliverables: summary json: imcc_last, imcc_avg60, ses_last, ses_avg60, m_c, drc, capital
frame: DIKETAHUI: IMCC series [T], SES series [T], DRC; FRTB plus factor or exceptions. DITANYAKAN: capital. RUMUS: card Core 5 capital = max(IMCC_{t-1} + SES_{t-1}, m_c IMCC_avg60 + SES_avg60) + DRC; m_c = 1.5 + plus (FRTB table). JAWAB: 1) last and 60-day averages. 2) m_c. 3) max. 4) add DRC. 5) components.
formulas: CA = max(IMCC_{t-1} + SES_{t-1}, m_c IMCC_avg + SES_avg) + DRC

title: FRTB backtesting plus factor table
deliverables: summary json: exceptions, plus, m_c
frame: DIKETAHUI: exceptions of 99% VaR over 250 days. DITANYAKAN: FRTB plus factor and m_c. RUMUS: card Core 5 FRTB plus: 0-4: 0; 5: 0.20; 6: 0.26; 7: 0.33; 8: 0.38; 9: 0.42; >= 10: 0.50; m_c = 1.5 + plus. JAWAB: 1) count exceptions (strict). 2) lookup. 3) m_c.

title: ES 97.5% vs VaR 99% equivalence under normality
deliverables: summary json: es975_factor, var99_factor, ratio
frame: DIKETAHUI: sigma (or returns); optional t dof. DITANYAKAN: ES_97.5 vs VaR_99 multiples of sigma; ratio. RUMUS: normal ES_q = phi(z_q)/(1-q) sigma; VaR_99 = z_0.99 sigma; Student-t ES (standardised): f_nu(t_q)/(1-q) (nu + t_q^2)/(nu - 1) x sqrt((nu-2)/nu) (toolkit parametric_var_es dist='t'). JAWAB: 1) factors. 2) ratio. 3) t comparison shows ES > VaR for fat tails.

title: Kupiec POF test alongside traffic light
deliverables: summary json: n, x, rate, lr_pof, p_value, zone
frame: DIKETAHUI: hits [N] or (x, N); level q. DITANYAKAN: LR_POF, p-value, reject flag, traffic-light zone. RUMUS: p = 1 - q; LR = -2[(N-x) ln(1-p) + x ln p - (N-x) ln(1 - x/N) - x ln(x/N)] (0 ln 0 = 0); p-value = chi2_1.sf(LR); toolkit kupiec_pof(x, N, level), basel_traffic_light. JAWAB: 1) x. 2) LR. 3) p-value. 4) zone. 5) decision at stated alpha.

title: Deriving traffic-light zone boundaries from the binomial
deliverables: per-count table: k, pmf, cdf, zone
frame: DIKETAHUI: N (250), p = 1 - q (0.01). DITANYAKAN: binomial pmf/cdf per k and zones. RUMUS: P(X <= k) = binom.cdf(k, N, p); green while cdf < 0.95, yellow while cdf < 0.9999, red beyond (BCBS 1996). JAWAB: 1) k = 0..kmax. 2) pmf, cdf. 3) zone per k. 4) check boundaries match card Core 4 (green 0-4, red >= 10).

title: Christoffersen independence and conditional coverage
deliverables: summary json: n00, n01, n10, n11, lr_ind, lr_cc, p_values
frame: DIKETAHUI: hits [N]; level. DITANYAKAN: LR_ind, LR_cc, p-values. RUMUS: pi01 = n01/(n00+n01), pi11 = n11/(n10+n11), pi = (n01+n11)/total; LR_ind = -2 ln[(1-pi)^(n00+n10) pi^(n01+n11)/((1-pi01)^n00 pi01^n01 (1-pi11)^n10 pi11^n11)]; LR_cc = LR_pof + LR_ind ~ chi2_2; toolkit christoffersen_independence(hits), christoffersen_cc(hits, level). JAWAB: 1) transitions. 2) LRs. 3) p-values.

title: Standardised approach credit RWA by external rating
deliverables: per-exposure table: exposure, rating, risk_weight, rwa
summary json: total_rwa, capital_8pct
frame: DIKETAHUI: exposures [M] with EAD and rating. DITANYAKAN: RW, RWA per exposure, total RWA, capital at 8%. RUMUS: card Core 6 Basel III corporate: AAA..AA- 20%, A+..A- 50%, BBB+..BBB- 75% (Basel II 100%), BB+..BB- 100%, below BB- 150%, unrated 100%; RWA = RW x EAD; capital = 8% RWA. JAWAB: 1) map ratings to buckets (state regime). 2) RW. 3) RWA. 4) totals. 5) capital.
pitfalls: Basel II vs III BBB weight

title: IRB capital requirement K and RWA
deliverables: per-exposure table: pd, lgd, ead, rho, b, k, rwa
summary json: total rwa
frame: DIKETAHUI: PD, LGD, EAD, M per exposure [M]; asset class. DITANYAKAN: K, RWA. RUMUS: corporate rho = 0.12 w + 0.24 (1 - w), w = (1 - e^(-50 PD))/(1 - e^-50); b = (0.11852 - 0.05478 ln PD)^2; K = LGD[Phi((Phi^-1(PD) + sqrt(rho) Phi^-1(0.999))/sqrt(1-rho)) - PD] (1 + (M - 2.5) b)/(1 - 1.5 b); RWA = 12.5 K EAD (card Core 6); toolkit basel_irb_capital(pd, lgd, rho, maturity, asset_class). JAWAB: 1) floor PD (0.03% Basel II/0.05% Basel III as stated). 2) rho, b. 3) K. 4) RWA.
formulas: K = LGD[Phi((Phi^-1(PD) + sqrt(rho) Phi^-1(0.999))/sqrt(1-rho)) - PD] MA
pitfalls: using 1/(1-1.5b) twice or omitting the -PD (EL) term

title: Capital ratios against minimums and buffers
deliverables: summary json: cet1_ratio, tier1_ratio, total_ratio, requirements, surplus
frame: DIKETAHUI: CET1, AT1, Tier 2 amounts; RWA (credit + market + op). DITANYAKAN: ratios, compliance, shortfall. RUMUS: card Core 6 CET1/RWA >= 4.5% (+ 2.5% conservation buffer + CCyB), Tier1 = CET1 + AT1 >= 6%, total = Tier1 + T2 >= 8% (+ buffers); shortfall = required x RWA - capital. JAWAB: 1) ratios. 2) requirements with buffers stated. 3) surplus/shortfall in currency.

title: Leverage ratio check
deliverables: summary json: tier1, exposure, leverage_ratio, required, surplus
frame: DIKETAHUI: Tier 1 capital; on-balance exposures; derivatives exposures; SFTs; off-balance items with CCFs. DITANYAKAN: leverage ratio and compliance. RUMUS: card Core 6 LR = Tier1 / exposure measure >= 3%; exposure = on-balance + derivatives (replacement cost + PFE) + SFT + CCF x off-balance. JAWAB: 1) exposure components. 2) sum. 3) ratio. 4) surplus = Tier1 - 3% exposure.

title: Total RWA aggregation across risk types
deliverables: summary json: rwa_credit, rwa_market, rwa_op, rwa_total
frame: DIKETAHUI: credit RWA; market risk capital charge; op risk capital charge. DITANYAKAN: total RWA. RUMUS: RWA_market = 12.5 x K_market; RWA_op = 12.5 x K_op; total = credit + market + op (12.5 = 1/8%). JAWAB: 1) convert charges. 2) sum. 3) ratios if capital given.

title: Operational risk basic indicator approach
deliverables: summary json: gi_years, positive_years, capital
frame: DIKETAHUI: annual gross income for 3 years. DITANYAKAN: op risk capital. RUMUS: K = alpha x mean(GI_y over years with GI_y > 0), alpha = 15% (Basel II); negative or zero years excluded from numerator and denominator. JAWAB: 1) filter positive years. 2) mean. 3) x alpha.

title: Operational risk standardised approach by business line
deliverables: per-year table: year, sum beta gi
summary json: capital
frame: DIKETAHUI: GI per business line per year [3 x 8]. DITANYAKAN: TSA capital. RUMUS: betas: retail banking, asset management, retail brokerage 12%; commercial banking, agency services 15%; corporate finance, trading and sales, payment and settlement 18%; K = (1/3) sum_y max(sum_j beta_j GI_jy, 0). JAWAB: 1) map lines to betas. 2) yearly weighted sum. 3) floor at 0. 4) average over 3.

title: Basel III standardised measurement approach for op risk
deliverables: summary json: bi, bic, lc, ilm, orc
frame: DIKETAHUI: business indicator BI (currency, bn); annual op losses over 10 years. DITANYAKAN: BIC, LC, ILM, ORC. RUMUS: BIC marginal: 12% on BI <= 1bn, 15% on 1-30bn, 18% above 30bn (BCBS d424); LC = 15 x average annual loss; ILM = ln(e - 1 + (LC/BIC)^0.8); ORC = BIC x ILM (bucket 1: ILM = 1). JAWAB: 1) BIC by bucket pieces. 2) LC. 3) ILM. 4) ORC; RWA = 12.5 ORC.
pitfalls: applying 18% to the whole BI instead of marginally

title: CTA vol targeting with equal risk budget per asset
deliverables: per-date x asset table [T x N]: weights
summary json: realised vol
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N]; signals [T x N] (+1/-1); target vol (annual); vol estimator (EWMA/rolling); N. DITANYAKAN: weights [T x N], portfolio returns [T], realised vol. RUMUS: card Core 7 w_i,t = s_i,t (target/N)/sigma_i,t (annualised sigma); target/sqrt(N) only if stated; card V6 a weights at t applied to r_{t+1}. JAWAB: 1) sigma per asset (lagged). 2) raw weights. 3) caps. 4) r_p,t = sum w_{t-1} r_t. 5) realised vol sqrt(252) std.
pitfalls: daily sigma with annual target (unit mismatch)

title: Portfolio-level vol scaling with a leverage cap
deliverables: per-date table: date, sigma_p_hat, scale, gross_leverage
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw weights [T x N]; covariance estimate or past portfolio returns; target; cap L. DITANYAKAN: scaled weights and leverage. RUMUS: card Core 7 sigma_p_hat = sqrt(w' Sigma w) (annualised) or std of lagged-weight portfolio returns; w = w_raw sigma_target/sigma_p_hat; if sum|w| > L scale by L/sum|w|. JAWAB: 1) sigma_p per date (info through t-1). 2) scale. 3) gross cap. 4) apply to next return. 5) report leverage series.

title: Vol-targeted strategy with RiskMetrics EWMA forecast
deliverables: per-date table: date, sigma_ewma, leverage, strategy_return
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T]; lambda (or span); seed rule; target vol annual; leverage cap. DITANYAKAN: sigma series, leverage, strategy returns. RUMUS: card V2-V3 sigma^2_t = lambda sigma^2_{t-1} + (1-lambda) r^2_{t-1}, seeded with first squared return (pandas adjust=True is not the recursion); alpha = 2/(span+1) if span; lev_t = min(target/(sqrt(252) sigma_t), cap); r_s,t = lev_{t-1} r_t; toolkit ewma_sigma_series, ewma_vol. JAWAB: 1) recursion. 2) annualise. 3) leverage. 4) lag. 5) stats.

title: Vol targeting with a GARCH(1,1) forecast
deliverables: per-date table: sigma_garch, leverage, strategy_return
summary json: omega, alpha, beta, persistence
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T]; fit window/refit rule; target; cap. DITANYAKAN: GARCH params, one-step sigma series, leverage, returns. RUMUS: card Conventions: fit on decimal returns (or 100x and rescale omega/1e4); sigma^2_{t+1} = omega + a r_t^2 + b sigma^2_t; leverage = target/(sqrt(252) sigma_{t+1}); toolkit fit_garch11(returns). JAWAB: 1) fit. 2) filter variance. 3) one-step forecasts (not in-sample sigma_t). 4) leverage, cap. 5) strategy returns.
formulas: sigma2_{t+1} = omega + a r_t^2 + b sigma2_t

title: Time-series momentum signal with vol scaling
deliverables: per-date x asset table: signal, weight
summary json: annual return, vol, sharpe
frame: DIKETAHUI: prices [T x N] (daily or monthly); lookback L; target vol; vol estimator. DITANYAKAN: signals, weights, strategy returns, stats. RUMUS: s_i,t = sign(P_t/P_{t-L} - 1) (+1/-1 if 'no flat state'); w = s target/(N sigma) (card Core 7); r = sum w_{t-1} r_t (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012); toolkit momentum_signal, performance_summary. JAWAB: 1) returns. 2) signal at t using data through t. 3) vol. 4) weights. 5) lagged returns. 6) stats.

title: Per-asset clip and gross leverage cap
deliverables: per-date x asset table: weights_capped
summary json: n_clipped, max gross
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw weights [T x N]; per-asset limit L_asset; gross limit L. DITANYAKAN: capped weights. RUMUS: card Core 7 step 1 w_i = clip(w_i, -L_asset, L_asset); step 2 if sum|w| > L: w = w L/sum|w| (order as stated). JAWAB: 1) clip. 2) gross. 3) check |w_i| <= L_asset and sum|w| <= L. 4) counts of binding dates.

title: Performance statistics of a vol-targeted strategy
deliverables: summary json: ann_return, ann_vol, sharpe, max_drawdown, calmar, realised_vs_target
frame: DIKETAHUI: strategy daily returns [T]; rf; definitions. DITANYAKAN: stats. RUMUS: ann return arithmetic 252 mean or CAGR prod(1+r)^(252/T) - 1 (as stated); vol sqrt(252) std (ddof stated); Sharpe = (mean - rf) sqrt(252)/std; MDD = min(equity/cummax - 1) (sign stated); Calmar = ann return/|MDD|; toolkit performance_summary, sharpe, max_drawdown, annualized_vol. JAWAB: 1) equity. 2) each stat. 3) realised vs target vol.

title: EWMA volatility: lambda vs span conventions
deliverables: summary json: lambda, alpha, sigma_daily, sigma_annual
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T]; decay as lambda, span or half-life; seed. DITANYAKAN: latest EWMA vol daily and annual. RUMUS: card V2 alpha = 1 - lambda; span: alpha = 2/(span+1); half-life h: lambda = 0.5^(1/h); recursion with pandas ewm(alpha, adjust=False) after seeding; toolkit ewma_vol(returns, lam, init). JAWAB: 1) convert to lambda. 2) seed (V3). 3) recursion. 4) sqrt, x sqrt(252).

title: GARCH(1,1) fit: units, persistence and long-run variance
deliverables: summary json: omega, alpha, beta, persistence, lrv_daily, vol_annual
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T] (decimal); mean model. DITANYAKAN: parameters, persistence, LRV, annual vol. RUMUS: card Conventions arch_model(r, mean='Constant' or 'Zero', vol='GARCH', p=1, q=1, rescale=False); if fitted on 100 r: omega/1e4; persistence a + b; LRV = omega/(1 - a - b); annual = sqrt(252 LRV); toolkit fit_garch11. JAWAB: 1) fit. 2) units. 3) derived. 4) check a, b >= 0, a + b < 1, LRV near sample variance.

title: GARCH one-step forecast vs in-sample conditional volatility
deliverables: summary json: sigma_T_insample, sigma_T1_forecast
frame: DIKETAHUI: fitted GARCH(1,1) and returns [T]. DITANYAKAN: sigma_{T+1} (forecast). RUMUS: card Conventions sigma^2_{T+1} = omega + a (r_T - mu)^2 + b sigma^2_T = res.forecast(horizon=1).variance.iloc[-1, 0]; conditional_volatility[-1] = sigma_T (different). JAWAB: 1) last residual. 2) recursion. 3) compare with arch forecast. 4) report units.
formulas: sigma2_{T+1} = omega + a eps_T^2 + b sigma2_T

title: UCITS absolute VaR limit check
deliverables: summary json: var_1d, var_20d, nav, limit, utilisation, compliant
frame: DIKETAHUI: fund daily returns (>= 1y) or holdings; NAV; level 99%. DITANYAKAN: 20-day 99% VaR, % NAV, compliance. RUMUS: card Conventions UCITS (CESR/10-788): absolute VaR <= 20% NAV at 99%, 20-day holding, >= 1y history; VaR_20 = sqrt(20) VaR_1 (if scaling allowed). JAWAB: 1) 1-day VaR (stated model). 2) scale to 20. 3) VaR/NAV. 4) utilisation = (VaR/NAV)/20%. 5) flag.

title: UCITS relative VaR against a reference portfolio
deliverables: summary json: var_fund, var_ref, ratio, compliant
frame: DIKETAHUI: fund and reference portfolio returns [T] (or holdings); level; horizon. DITANYAKAN: VaR ratio and compliance. RUMUS: card Conventions relative VaR: VaR_fund <= 2 x VaR_reference (same model, horizon, confidence). JAWAB: 1) both VaRs consistently. 2) ratio. 3) flag ratio <= 2.

title: UCITS commitment approach global exposure
deliverables: per-position table: commitment
summary json: gross, net, global_exposure_pct
frame: DIKETAHUI: derivative positions (futures notional, options delta, FX forwards); NAV. DITANYAKAN: global exposure % NAV. RUMUS: commitment = market value of equivalent underlying (futures: contracts x multiplier x price; options: delta x contracts x multiplier x underlying price); net offsetting positions on the same underlying; global exposure <= 100% NAV (card Conventions). JAWAB: 1) commitments. 2) netting. 3) sum absolute. 4) % NAV, flag.
formulas: option commitment = delta x n x mult x S

title: Incremental risk charge from simulated losses
deliverables: summary json: irc, irc_avg12w, capital
frame: DIKETAHUI: simulated 1-year loss scenarios [n] (default + migration) or inputs to simulate; recent IRC values. DITANYAKAN: IRC and its charge. title: FRTB default risk charge with JTD netting and HBR
deliverables: per-position table: jtd
per-bucket table: net_long, net_short, hbr, drc
frame: DIKETAHUI: positions (notional, MtM P&L, LGD, rating, long/short) per bucket. DITANYAKAN: JTD, HBR, DRC. RUMUS: JTD_long = max(LGD x notional + P&L, 0), JTD_short = min(LGD x notional + P&L, 0); net per obligor; HBR = sum net long/(sum net long + sum |net short|); DRC_b = max(sum RW_i JTD_long - HBR sum RW_i |JTD_short|, 0); total = sum of buckets (SA-DRC). JAWAB: 1) JTD. 2) obligor netting. 3) HBR. 4) DRC per bucket. 5) total.
formulas: DRC = max(sum RW JTD_L - HBR sum RW |JTD_S|, 0)

title: Capital allocation by component VaR (Euler)

RUMUS: sigma_p = sqrt(w' Sigma w); MVaR_i = z (Sigma w)_i/sigma_p; CVaR_i = w_i MVaR_i; sum CVaR_i = VaR_p; toolkit component_var(weights, cov, level, value, measure). title: Daily capital time series from rolling VaR

JAWAB: 1) rolling VaR [T-W]. 2) sVaR (fixed or rolling). 3) rolling averages (min_periods 60). 4) capital per date. 5) table.

title: Square-root-of-time with autocorrelated returns
deliverables: summary json: rho1, factor_sqrt, factor_ar1, var_h
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily returns [T]; horizon h. DITANYAKAN: h-day variance scaling with autocorrelation. RUMUS: Var(R_h) = sigma^2 [h + 2 sum_{k=1..h-1} (h - k) rho_k]; AR(1) rho_k = rho^k; VaR_h = z sigma sqrt(factor). JAWAB: 1) sigma, rho_k (lags). 2) factor. 3) VaR_h. 4) compare with sqrt(h).

title: Holding-period VaR with non-zero drift
deliverables: summary json: mu, sigma, var_h_zero_mean, var_h_with_mean
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily mu, sigma; h; q. DITANYAKAN: h-day VaR with and without mean. RUMUS: card Core 3 VaR_h = z_q sigma sqrt(h) - mu h; zero mean: z_q sigma sqrt(h); log-normal value: V(1 - exp(mu h - z sigma sqrt(h))). JAWAB: 1) estimate mu, sigma. 2) both versions. 3) currency.
formulas: VaR_h = z sigma sqrt(h) - mu h

title: SA-CCR exposure at default for a netting set
deliverables: summary json: rc, addon, multiplier, pfe, ead
frame: DIKETAHUI: netting set MtM V; collateral C; aggregate add-on (or trade inputs for add-on). DITANYAKAN: RC, PFE, EAD. RUMUS: unmargined RC = max(V - C, 0); multiplier = min(1, 0.05 + 0.95 exp((V - C)/(2 x 0.95 x AddOn))); PFE = multiplier x AddOn; EAD = 1.4 (RC + PFE). JAWAB: 1) RC. 2) add-on (stated). 3) multiplier. 4) EAD. 5) RWA = RW x EAD if asked.

title: Stress-test capital from scenario shocks

title: FRTB P&L attribution test (Spearman and KS)
deliverables: summary json: spearman, ks, zone
frame: DIKETAHUI: HPL [T] and RTPL [T] (250 days). DITANYAKAN: Spearman correlation, KS statistic, PLA zone. RUMUS: MAR32: Spearman of HPL vs RTPL; KS = max |F_HPL - F_RTPL| (two-sample, scipy ks_2samp statistic); green: Spearman > 0.80 and KS < 0.09; red: Spearman < 0.70 or KS > 0.12; else amber. JAWAB: 1) align days. 2) statistics. 3) zone.
